de1.P1.C10.ly_do: Loi giai da chung minh IJ song song BD va IJ khong nam trong (SBD) nen IJ song song (SBD), tuc phuong an D; dap an luu B la sai chu cai.

de1.P1.C11.ly_do: Loi giai da chi ro menh de o phuong an C (gioi han ti so bang +vo cung khi chua ro dau v_n) la sai; dap an luu B la sai chu cai.

de1.P1.C12.ly_do: Loi giai tinh dung 3.2-4.3=-6, tuc phuong an C; dap an luu D la sai chu cai.
